lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits, organized into distinct horizontal rows and vertical columns across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal axes of spots, forming a coordinate-like grid of high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three visible horizontal ridges running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a high density of small, high-luminance blobs, exhibiting a more random spatial distribution compared to the lateral flank constellation.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense field of small, high-luminance circular markers, exhibiting a higher spatial frequency than the primary flank pattern.
